'''Nintuk''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Talz/Legends|Talz]] who lived during the reign of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]].<ref name="BHC" /> They were of average height for a Talz, standing at 2.1 [[Meter/Legends|meters]], and slightly above average weight, at 91 [[Kilogram/Legends|kilograms]].<ref name="heightweight">''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]'' notes that [[Talz/Legends|Talz]] stand between 2 - 2.5 [[Meter/Legends|meters]] tall and have an average weight of 90 [[Kilogram/Legends|kilograms]], while ''[[The Bounty Hunter Code: From the Files of Boba Fett]]'' has the specific height and weight of Nintuk.</ref> During [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine's]] reign,<ref name="Palps">The wanted poster in ''[[The Bounty Hunter Code: From the Files of Boba Fett]]'' says "By proclamation of his [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] majesty [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]]," suggesting the [[Bounty/Legends|bounty]] was made during Palpatine's reign. Palpatine was Emperor from the Empire's [[Proclamation of the New Order|inception]] in the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]] till his [[Death/Legends|death]] in [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]], according to ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''.</ref> Nintuk was charged by the Empire with being responsible for the murder of [[Imperial Military/Legends|Imperial personnel]]. A [[Bounty/Legends|bounty]] of 75,000 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] was then issued by proclamation of the Emperor for either her capture, or proof of her [[Death/Legends|death]], though the bounty was restricted to [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunters]] holding an [[Imperial Peace-Keeping Certificate/Legends|Imperial Peace-Keeping Certificate]], an Imperial-issued license to allow an individual to legally hunt bounties. Nintuk's wanted poster was used in the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] edition of the [[Bounty Hunters Guild Handbook]] and pictured them wearing a necklace.<ref name="BHC" />

==Behind the scenes==
Nintuk was first described and pictured as the subject of a wanted poster in ''[[The Bounty Hunter Code: From the Files of Boba Fett]]'', which was released in [[2013]] and written by [[Daniel Wallace]], [[Ryder Windham]] and [[Jason Fry]].<ref name="BHC" />
